root_cause.text: The BPF local storage deletion helpers can be invoked from NMI context, where deferring memory freeing via kfree_rcu(), call_rcu(), or call_rcu_tasks_trace() is unsafe and can cause deadlocks because these RCU mechanisms are not NMI-safe.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an `in_nmi()` check in `bpf_selem_unlink()`, returning -EOPNOTSUPP to prevent deletion in NMI. The commit message states "local storage may deadlock when deferring freeing selem or local storage through kfree_rcu(), call_rcu() or call_rcu_tasks_trace() in NMI or reentrant." The patch targets the helper path (`bpf_xxx_storage_delete()`), and explicitly notes that `bpf_selem_unlink_nofail()` is safe because it is only called during map or owner teardown, which never runs in NMI.
